pay_prior_experience_005.answer: yes. Experience is credited based on verified hours per school year (570 hours for 184-day contracts, 600 for 194-day, 785 for 206-day). Hours may not be totaled across years. Substitute teaching is not recognized. Employee responsible for verification. Placement also references Article 10 for additional criteria.
pay_prior_experience_005.evidence: Five hundred seventy (570) hours of verified experience in a single school year will count as a year of experience for one hundred eighty-four (184)-day contracts... Substitute teaching is not recognized as teaching experience.
